subject: MAP: BeaconHealth hosting sequencing & timeline
messages:
From: Sara Perez <sara.perez@beaconhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@beaconhealth.com
Date: 2026-05-22T15:12:00Z
Subject: MAP kickoff: hosting & region constraints

Hi Jordan / team,

Thanks for the intro call earlier today. Beacon wants to lock down a mutual action plan so we can evaluate Redwood and firm up the hosting decision. A few constraints from our side:
- PHI workloads must remain in US regions and be under a contract that supports customer-managed KMS (HSM preferred).
- We need SOC 2 evidence and a short summary of audit controls up front.
- Initial acceptance testing should include latency < 250ms p99 for the 512-token path and throughput of 25 qps for batched inference.

We expect a 6-week evaluation window and would like a proposed MAP that calls out: PoC scope, acceptance criteria, timeline to production (hosted/dedicated/private options), and any dependencies on legal/procurement.

I've attached our security questionnaire and a high-level timeline. Can you share a recommended sequence (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and an estimated date to close? Our procurement lead (CC) will want a commercial cadence.

Cheers,
Sara
Sara Perez
CTO, Beacon Health
[sent from mobile]

Attachment: Beacon_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Marissa / Priyom — looping you in to turn Sara's ask into a concrete MAP. High level thinking: start with a non-PHI PoC on Hosted (US-East) to validate latency and batch behavior, then run a short Dedicated trial for PHI workloads (VPC + KMS) and plan Private/on-prem only if there are gating regulatory items.

Ask: can you draft a 6-week MAP with milestones for the two-phase approach (Hosted -> Dedicated) and include acceptance tests (latency, throughput, quality checks)? Also note any infra or engineering tasks that would lengthen the timeline (e.g., KMS onboarding, SOC evidence packaging). Priyom — commercial ask: rough cost delta for a 3-month Dedicated trial so we can give Beacon an initial budget.

I will respond to Sara tonight with a summarized plan and attach our MAP draft + SOC summary.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-24T10:02:00Z
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff: hosting & region constraints

Jordan — quick technical readout and recommended evaluation plan.

Recommendation summary:
- Phase 1 (2 weeks): Hosted PoC in us-east1 for non-PHI telemetry and functional acceptance. Validate model variants (fp16 vs int8), steady-state latency at target load, and KV/prefix cache behavior. Use a small representative prompt set (we should ask Beacon for 200 canonical prompts).
- Phase 2 (4 weeks): Dedicated trial in a customer-dedicated pool inside a US region with VPC peering and customer-managed KMS. This covers PHI while keeping our control plane hosted (optional Private if Beacon insists on private control plane).

Acceptance criteria (examples):
- Latency: p99 < 250ms for 512 tokens under 25 qps batched load
- Throughput: maintain >=25 qps for 512-token average with <3% error rate
- Quality: exact-match rate on seeded prompt set >= 92% vs baseline model
- Security: SOC 2 summary + KMS configuration validated; network diagrams completed

Engineering/dependencies:
- KMS onboarding (customer KMS keys in Dedicated) — estimate 7 business days to validate integration and key rotation policies
- VPC peering and firewall rules — 2–3 business days with customer networking team
- Quantization/variant verification — 3 business days for one model family

I'll attach a draft MAP workbook with milestones and required Beacon inputs (prompt set, traffic shape, legal contact). Also added a short runbook for rollback to Hosted if Dedicated onboarding hits a blocker.

Attachments: MAP_Beacon_v1.xlsx (workbook stub)

—Marissa

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-25T13:45:00Z
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff: hosting & region constraints

Adding the commercial lens. Two items to include in the MAP before we share externally:
1) Pricing snapshot — Estimated cost for a 4-week Dedicated trial (reserved baseline) + delta vs hosted per-token run rates. We can show a short-term trial credit to accelerate decisioning (we should be prepared to offer 20% off list for the pilot).
2) Contract timeline — procurement often needs a draft MSA and data processing agreement; ask Beacon legal for a single point of contact and target completion date.

Suggested close plan:
- Week 0: MAP signed and prompt set delivered
- Weeks 1–2: Hosted PoC (non-PHI) — collection of telemetry and QA
- Weeks 3–6: Dedicated trial (PHI) — KMS + network validation, acceptance tests
- Target close: end of week 9 (6 weeks of evaluation plus procurement) — ask Beacon if they can target 2026-06-30 as production go/no-go.

Jordan — I'll draft a pricing appendix. Marissa — if you can capture the KMS runbook steps in the workbook, we can hand to their infra team.

—Priyom

Subject: MAP proposal & proposed sequencing (Hosted -> Dedicated) — Beacon Health

Sara — thanks for the clear constraints. Quick summary and proposed MAP steps below. Please reply with confirmation of the legal contact and whether Beacon can provide the 200-prompt seed set by next Monday.

Proposed sequence (recommended):
1) Hosted PoC (us-east1) — 2 weeks, non-PHI workloads only. Objectives: validate latency and batching behavior, collect telemetry for model selection.
2) Dedicated trial (US region) — 4 weeks for PHI. Setup: VPC peering, customer-managed KMS (HSM optional), SOC 2 evidence review. This will be our default production recommendation if your procurement/legal require managed KMS and VPC isolation.
3) Private deployment — only if Beacon requires an air-gapped control plane; this would extend timeline by 4–6 weeks and move to a separate commercial contract.

Milestones & acceptance criteria (high level):
- MAP signed and prompt set received (Week 0)
- Hosted PoC complete with latency/throughput report (end of Week 2)
- Dedicated trial environment validated (end of Week 4 of Dedicated phase)
- Final acceptance and procurement sign-off (target: 2026-06-30)

Attachments: MAP_Beacon_v1.xlsx (workbook — timeline, milestones, responsibilities), SOC2_summary.pdf (one-page stub with key controls).

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bBeaconMAP (MAP workbook), HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8732

If that sequencing looks good, I'll set up a 30-minute MAP walk-through with your procurement and infra contacts early next week.

Best,
